claims.text: Panoptic Sentiment Sextuple Extraction recognizes holder, target, aspect, opinion, sentiment, and rationale from multi-turn multi-party multimodal dialogue.
Sentiment Flipping Analysis detects dynamic sentiment transformation throughout conversation along with causal reasons.
PanoSent is a multimodal conversational aspect-based sentiment analysis benchmark dataset created with manual and automatic annotations.

evidence.description: The authors propose Panoptic Sentiment Sextuple Extraction, panoramically recognizing holder, target, aspect, opinion, sentiment, rationale from multi-turn multi-party multimodal dialogue.
The authors propose Sentiment Flipping Analysis, detecting the dynamic sentiment transformation throughout the conversation with the causal reasons.

The authors construct PanoSent, a dataset annotated both manually and automatically, featuring high quality, large scale, multimodality, multilingualism, multi-scenarios, and covering both implicit and explicit sentiment elements.

methodologies.name: Chain-of-Sentiment reasoning framework with Sentica and paraphrase verification
methodologies.description: A multimodal reasoning framework utilizing a multimodal large language model named Sentica alongside a paraphrase-based verification mechanism.

limitations.text: Existing Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis lacks integration of multimodality, conversation context, fine-granularity, changing sentiment dynamics, and cognitive causal rationales.
